fields: h, intro, items [{t, d, hold, days}] (days: the phase's span in days for the grid; a phase without days is the routine plan that runs on to the end of the year), grid {points, days, rows, cols, unit} (the grid's size and axis words; points x days is the total shown), year {weeks, months, label} (52, 12).
best_for: PqCalendar sets PQ phases as a short numbered stack beside one instrument readout: the sample count as a giant light numeral, the sampling grid that makes it and a tick scale of the year (look `pq-calendar`, steps block).

block.intro: Conductivity, total organic carbon and microbial count; at 12 sample points, 28 days make 336 samples.

items.d: At least 2 weeks of daily samples at every step and point of use. No production use.
At least 2 more weeks, same sampling, procedures in use. Production use with your approval.
A reduced routine plan, trended, until the phases cover at least 12 months.
